title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons Work Authorization Amount
content:
**Calculation clause.** The work-authorization amount of an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider is fixed on the rider's most recently placed service request, using the figures of that request's covered coverage determination.

1. The **authorized work cost** is the repair estimate on that determination.
2. The **authorized item limit** is the rider's per-request cap, as published in the schedule of benefit limits.
3. The **work-authorization amount** is the lowest of:
   - the authorized work cost;
   - the authorized item limit, less the repair, replacement and cash-in-lieu amounts already authorized on the rider for the same component in the current term, net of every reversal recorded for that component; and
   - the rider's term cap, less the rider benefit authorized in the current term net of reversals;
   never below zero, and rounded to the cent.
4. A rider benefit counts as **authorized in the current term** when the whole months from its date to the authorization date are fewer than one more than the whole months from the term start date to the authorization date.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider, per-request cap and term cap of USD 2000.00 as published)

| Case | Repair estimate | Same component already authorized in term, net | Rider benefit authorized in term, net | Item limit room | Term cap room | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 850.00 | 0.00 | 300.00 | 2000.00 | 1700.00 | 850.00 |
| B | 850.00 | 0.00 | 1400.00 | 2000.00 | 600.00 | 600.00 |
| C | 850.00 | 1600.00 | 1600.00 | 400.00 | 400.00 | 400.00 |
| D | 850.00 | 0.00 | 2000.00 | 2000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

In case C the earlier authorizations on the same component were for USD 1,700.00, and a reversal of USD 100.00 is recorded for that component, leaving USD 1,600.00 net.

## Current-term test (hypothetical dates)

Term start date 1 April; authorization date 20 June. The whole months from 1 April to 20 June are 2, so a benefit counts when the whole months from its date to 20 June are fewer than 3: one dated 25 April (1 whole month) counts; one dated 15 March (3 whole months) does not.
